name: Chisa-chan o (Sex de) Sukuukai
original_name: 千紗ちゃんを(セックスで)救う会
source:
Your effort is necessary to give Chisa-chan a chance to recover.
We sincerely ask for your kind support.

(She knows nothing comes without a price.
She is willing to give some services in return for your compensation...)

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ304419.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
要讓小千紗得到康復的機會，需要你出一份力。衷心懇請各位慷慨相助。

（她明白，世上沒有不付代價的好事。作為捐助的回報，她願意提供一些特別服務……）

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ304419.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
